goal: Allow test networks with -acceptnonstdtxn=1 to accept non-standard script transactions into the mempool
Let developers test future soft forks and experimental opcodes without needing to mine them directly into blocks
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Broad concept approval for testing soft forks and experimental transactions on testnets (benthecarman, ismaelsadeeq)
Approach approved after resolving discussion around compile-time flag validation (sedited, fjahr)
Reviewed validation logic and found it correct (instagibbs)
Unaddressed objection: changes -acceptnonstdtxn beyond expected Knots behavior (luke-jr)
Minor open suggestions remain regarding failure logging and release notes (instagibbs, fjahr)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it is a testnet-only convenience feature for testing experimental opcodes and soft forks
It spares developers from having to mine transactions directly into blocks when testing new script rules
The impact is limited to non-production test networks and is reasonably deferrable
